Subject: Q2 stage tidy & upsell action plan — Catalyst Health

Hi team,

Quick one to align on the Q2 review and make sure the upsell opportunities for Catalyst Health are in the right stages for the upcoming commit review on Friday. I pulled a short stage summary and a commit tracker and attached both — please confirm the stage you own and the committed value (if any) by EOD Wednesday so finance can lock numbers for the forecast scrub.

Key asks:
- Marissa: confirm CS health signal and whether you want to move CH-Expansion-2 from "Opportunity" -> "Commit": include any required milestones.
- Diego: confirm technical blocker status for CH-PoC-Upgrade and whether the ETA moves the expected close out of Q2.
- Anna / Procurement: any timeline or PO constraints we should bake into the commit?

Attachments: [Attachment: stage_summary_Q2.csv (csv, 24KB)], [Attachment: commit_tracker_Q2.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)]

Thanks,
Olga
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 stage tidy & upsell action plan — Catalyst Health

Thanks Olga — review below.

On CH-Expansion-2 (Account expansion for CareOps): CS signal is green: they completed the pilot health checklist and NPS was 8/10. We have two outstanding success milestones (1) data mapping review (complete this week) and (2) go-live readiness call (scheduled 3/24). If both remain on track, I support moving to Commit for Q2 with 60% probability of close (internal confidence: medium-high).

CH-PoC-Upgrade (diego): from a retention / adoption standpoint we see good product uptake but need Diego's confirm on infra reservations — we can't promise a firm ship date without that.

I updated the commit_tracker_Q2.xlsx with my notes (sheet 'CS-notes').

- Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Quick update from infra/dev side: CH-PoC-Upgrade has one gating dependency — GPU slot reservations for their preview environment. Engineering can provision the slot, but procurement needs to sign off on an additional reserved capacity line item for Dedicated during the preview window. If procurement signs the addendum by 3/22 we can keep the close in Q2; otherwise it slips to early Q3.

So: for forecasting purposes, I'd mark CH-PoC-Upgrade as "Possible (push to Q3 if procurement delay)" and set expected commit probability at 40%. I've added a comment in the tracker.

Hi Olga / Marissa / Diego,

Thanks for the summary — appreciate the clear asks. Quick notes from procurement/ops: we are aligned to prioritize the CH-Expansion-2 PO and expect to route a preliminary internal approval by 3/25. For the Dedicated capacity addendum, procurement needs formal pricing and an updated MSA amendment to expedite. I can flag this with our legal and procurement owners but we need the amendment draft by 3/18 to make the 3/22 sign-off window Diego mentioned.

Action items from our side:
- Procurement: target internal sign-off for expansion PO by 3/25.
- Legal/Procurement: request amendment draft by 3/18 to consider reserved capacity addendum.

I'll attach an internal timeline in a follow-up if helpful. For now, please proceed with staging CH-Expansion-2 as Commit with the contingency notes Diego outlined.
